recognize_zh: 兩個成熟淋巴球並排，核染色質緻密呈塊狀，左側細胞胞質內有同心弧狀排列的細絲狀包涵體，右側細胞胞質也有淡淡的線狀結構；在 CLL 抹片上這是細絲狀胞質包涵體。
features: Two mature lymphocytes with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin; nuclei slightly indented
Left cell: concentric, arc-like filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions
Right cell: fainter linear cytoplasmic filaments
Background crenated red cells and several platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin, slightly indented nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm. The left cell contains concentric arc-like filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions, and the right cell shows fainter linear filaments. Red cells are crenated, and platelets are present. In the setting of CLL, findings are consistent with CLL cells with filamentous intracytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have villous projections along the cell membrane and bland oval nuclei, confirmed by CD103/CD25/annexin A1 positivity.
Villous lymphocytes show polar short projections rather than internal filaments and are CD5-negative.
Plasmacytoid cells have basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and globular inclusions, typically in LPL.
